consequence.statement: Ingress resources defined with the networking.k8s.io/v1beta1 API version will no longer be recognized or processed by Traefik v3.
consequence.remediation: Update all Ingress resource definitions to use the networking.k8s.io/v1 API version.

assertion.statement: Traefik v3 removes support for the Kubernetes Ingress API Group networking.k8s.io/v1beta1; users must migrate to networking.k8s.io/v1.

checks.detail: networking.k8s.io/v1beta1 Ingress is not defined by any CRD of the snapshots (the snapshot may not hold every kind of the group)
the API version is not in the snapshots
